name: Dutchman Print
description: Prepare selected bodies and control printers through a local Print API v1 companion.

entries.name: print
entries.label: Start printing
entries.params: printer: id, job: id, confirmation: challenge id, summary: server summary

entries.name: cancel
entries.label: Cancel printing
entries.params: printer: id, job: id, confirmation: challenge id, summary: server summary

entries.name: pause
entries.label: Pause printing
entries.params: printer: id, confirmation: challenge id, summary: server summary

entries.name: resume
entries.label: Resume printing
entries.params: printer: id, confirmation: challenge id, summary: server summary

entries.name: clear
entries.label: Bed is clear
entries.params: printer: id, confirmation: challenge id, summary: server summary

entries.name: review
entries.label: Review machine action
entries.params: action: print|dispatch|cancel|pause|resume|clear|stop, printer: id, job: id for print/cancel, queue: entry id for dispatch

entries.name: stop
entries.label: Stop printing
entries.params: printer: id, confirmation: challenge id, summary: server summary

entries.name: dispatch
